# BBNI.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp5,674.0 against Rp3,320.0 (expected total return 82.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- F1 (loans 812,200, period FY2025A) and F6 (deposits 934,330, period FY2025A) are 30-Sep-2025 stocks, not 31-Dec-2025 balances: the F1 quote itself says "periode yang sama tahun sebelumnya sebesar Rp 812,2 triliun" (S15).
- The NIM input (3.26% FY2026E rising to 3.41% FY2030E) never reaches the 3.5% the bank reported for 9M-2026 (F9/S4), while §2 and §3 call 3.5% "closer to a floor than a mid-cycle level" and cost of funds is falling (2.83%
- The FY2026E revenue and cost lines are nine-month run-rates, not annual forecasts. FY2026E NOII is Rp18.90tn against Rp17.91tn already booked in 9M-2026 (S12), implying Q4-2026 NOII of ~Rp1.0tn versus ~Rp7.9tn in Q4-2025

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
